item.title: My First Post
item.description:
This is my first blog post on Glory in Christ.

I will be sharing my journey, testimony, and reflections on faith.

item.title: About Me
item.description:
I was born into a Muslim family and carried that identity for much of my life. Along the way, I faced a series of personal hardships that shook the foundations of what I believed about God, goodness, and purpose.

Those struggles led me into a season of deep questioning — wondering how a good God could exist in the midst of so much pain.

But in searching for answers, something unexpected happened. My journey to understand Allah led me instead to encounter the living God — one in essence, yet three in person. It wasn’t a sudden shift, but a gradual unveiling that transformed my understanding of truth, identity, and faith.
